name: Wicked Woodlands
location: Reed-Turner Woodland, 3849 Old McHenry Road, Long Grove
raw: Wicked Woodlands | Saturday, October 3rd | Reed-Turner Woodland | Tickets are $5 per person and must be purchased in advance. Children under 1 year old are free. Guests must select a session: 4:00 PM, 5:30 PM, or 7:00 PM. Each ticket includes 90 minutes of spine-tingling fun.

name: Sessions with Santa
location: Long Grove Park District, 3849 Old McHenry Road, Long Grove
raw: Join us for Sessions with Santa Sunday, December 6th | Long Grove Park District

name: Grove Trotters Walking Club
location: Long Grove (meeting location varies by trail)
raw: Grove Trotters Walking Club | This FREE club is for those who want to get-up, get out, and explore with your neighbors! We meet on the last Friday of the month to explore different trails and locations in Long Grove. Our next session will be August 28th at 10AM.
